source.says: A subarea of the TCC zone is designated as a Halsey Street storefront district. ... A map of the boundaries of the storefront district is provided in Figure 19.65.030(B).

inputs.taxlots: quadfit s2 taxlots (Metro RLIS, data/quadfit/s2_lots.parquet), used for the registration and the check

source.how: The COMPLEMENT of the figure's shading inside the figure's frame: the ground the map shows and does not shade. The grey Storefront District fill (grey level 150) was lifted from the raster by value, the legend swatch and north arrow masked, the taxlot lines inside the fill closed (3 px), polygonized, and subtracted from the figure's frame. The raster was registered to EPSG:2913 by matching its taxlot linework to the quadfit taxlots (FFT cross-correlation over scale and rotation): 2.345 ft per pixel, no rotation, 74 percent of the figure's line pixels on a rendered taxlot line. Land beyond the frame is not depicted and is NOT in this area, so a lot there reads False (the refusal stands), never True.
source.check: Overlaid on the figure, every TCC taxlot boundary lands on the figure's own lot lines. Of the 45 TCC lots: 3 tiny lots on 208th Pl are at least 96 percent in this area (unshaded); 34 are at least 90 percent shaded (in the district) and 3 east of 223rd lie wholly beyond the frame, so 37 read False; 5 are cut and unanswered -- the two tall lots north of Halsey between 208th Pl and Fairview Pkwy and the large lot south of Halsey there (shaded only along Halsey, 75, 76 and 81 percent outside), a small lot at 208th Pl (90 percent shaded) and one east of 223rd partly beyond the frame. Slivers under 1,000 sq ft dropped.
